title: When Should We Introduce Safety Interventions During Pretraining?
reasoning: The paper investigates safety curricula during pretraining, focusing on robustness to harmful content and the generation of safety rationales. It utilizes the 'MoralEducation' dataset to train models and benchmarks their safety using standard red-teaming and jailbreaking benchmarks, which inherently involves evaluating the model's adherence to ethical and moral boundaries.
